title: Amazon Personalize pricing - Consumption-based AWS service
clean_text: Amazon Personalize charges $0.05 per GB of data uploaded, $0.24 per training hour, and $0.15 per 1,000 recommendation requests. Minimum billing of 1 TPS per active campaign applies regardless of actual traffic. Free tier for first 2 months: up to 20 GB data, 100 training hours, 180,000 recommendation requests.
